description: A luxury hotel or restaurant rooftop terrace photographed at dusk, with an open view of a calm ocean and a distant city coastline illuminated along the horizon. The terrace floor is large-format cream or pale beige porcelain tile. Multiple square dining tables with glass tops and chrome pedestal bases are set for dinner with white porcelain plates, wine glasses, white napkins, and condiment sets. The dining chairs have a warm medium teak or mahogany wood arm frame with cream upholstered seat and back pads. Tables are set in a loose grid arrangement across the terrace. To the right, a full-height glass curtain wall with dark aluminium frames and a projecting teak or hardwood overhead structure marks the indoor-outdoor threshold. Clear glass balcony balustrades run along the terrace perimeter overlooking the ocean. The sky is a layered gradient from pale amber at the horizon through mauve and violet to a deep cool blue-grey overhead. A series of tall conical glowing sculptural forms in diffused white polypropylene stand at intervals along the terrace railing, each one radiating a different color — warm white, purple, green, and blue — creating a playful, festive atmosphere across the dining space. Camera is at a standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting a three-quarter wide establishing view of the terrace looking toward the ocean and the railing. The lens is a moderate wide angle. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
